wnba.Description: The Lynx remain favorites to win the WNBA championship, while the Aces, Valkyries, Dream and Fever all have shorter than 10-1 odds.

wnba.Description: As the semifinals wrap up this week, here are four pickups to add to your fantasy women's basketball lineups.

wnba.Headline: Diana Taurasi basketball honors: WNBA, Olympics, UConn
wnba.Description: During her basketball career, Diana Taurasi achieved MVP and All-Star honors, among other accolades. Check out her top titles now.

wnba.Headline: WNBA jersey retirements: Taurasi, Leslie, Bird, Hammon, more
wnba.Description: Numerous WNBA stars have had their numbers retired, including Maya Moore and Tamika Catchings. Find out which players have received the honor.

wnba.Headline: Diana Taurasi's No. 3 raised to the rafters in Phoenix
wnba.Description: The Mercury honored franchise legend Diana Taurasi by retiring her No. 3.

wnba.Headline: Phoenix Mercury honor Diana Taurasi, retire No. 3 jersey
wnba.Description: After the Phoenix Mercury's 88-85 loss to the Portland Fire on Sunday night, Diana Taurasi held court, detailing a Hall of Fame career that now includes a jersey retirement ceremony that felt "like the end and the beginning of so many things in my life."

wnba.Headline: Fever defeat Dream in OT to secure key win as season winds down
wnba.Description: The Fever defeated the Dream 95-91 in overtime Sunday. It was a game with playoff implications, and the environment inside State Farm Arena felt like the postseason.

wnba.Headline: Carla Leite helps Fire top Phoenix 88-85, spoiling celebration of former Mercury star Diana Taurasi
